title: Shrinkage Analysis Request Tool
short_desc: An internal app that 35–50 colleagues use every week to request and follow shrinkage analyses of moulded parts. I maintained and improved it.
problem: Requests for shrinkage analyses had to move through approvals and status updates without anyone chasing them.
built: Users submit requests in a simple app, and administrators manage them from a dashboard. Automated flows handle approvals, status updates, record-keeping and email notifications.
tech_notes: Two Power Apps front ends: a request form for users and a dashboard for administrators. I built and maintained the Power Automate flows behind them. The flows route approvals, update status, log each request and send notification emails.
